title: The Red Light District
physical_identity: Corrupted night city of steel and glass, a malevolent descendant of the Endless City; moonless sky lit by crimson city lights; psychoactive air; buildings bare and gutted.
scale_topology: Outdoor city, size unknown and possibly expanding; low-density outskirts to dense towers at core; bridges over a large body of water at the edge.
anomalies: no humans exist, any seen is deception
lighting_sound: Moonless sky, crimson light from the city; sweltering damp to icy drizzle with red lightning; a 'sadistic hum' near The Embassy.

entities.name: Servants (Entity 187)
entities.behavior: Stalk in groups, herd to dead ends, capture and restrain

entities.name: Ambassadors (Entity 141)
entities.behavior: Active around The Embassy; floating cubes per recording

entities.name: The Daughter
entities.behavior: Named in recording as sending victims via the Vortex

entities.name: Level 6.2 entity
entities.behavior: Deceives wanderers who end up imprisoned here

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Servants, Ambassadors (testimony: The Daughter)

entrances.method: Find dark alleyways, red-windowed buildings, or guarded bridges at the outskirts
entrances.quote: searching for dark alleyways, buildings with glowing red windows

entrances.method: Seduced by the entity there; imprisoned here via the Vortex
entrances.quote: Those seduced by Level 6.2 are ultimately imprisoned within the Red Light District
additional points of access exist than are currently known

exits.method: Bridges over water at the outskirts
exits.quote: they are usually guarded to prevent all escape
Further exits are hypothesized, but remain undetermined

signature_mechanic: Red-lit empty city whose air causes hallucinations (masks mitigate) while Servants stalk at a distance, herd the player into enclosed spaces, then capture; only known way out is guarded outskirts bridges.
verticality: Towers exist toward the core; interiors bare. Vortex is high in sky, not reachable.
conflicts_notes: Page body is a themed (CSS) layout. Link list includes Level 11.2 and 11.4 (navigation) not discussed in body. Interior content and exits are explicitly unknown.

key_quotes.quote: irredeemably corrupted hellscape of steel and glass
it can be mitigated by wearing facial coverings or masks
Water systems are non-functional throughout Level 11.3
There are no humans in the Red Light District. If you encounter one, it is a deception.
Avoid enclosed spaces and do not rest.
It has never been seen directly
Take caution, as they are usually guarded to prevent all escape.
